title: parse_int_list() ignores ranges written high-to-low
body:
`parse_int_list` in `boltons/strutils.py` silently drops a range whose
bounds are written in descending order, which printer-style page
ranges often contain:

```python
>>> parse_int_list("8-5")
[]          # expected [5, 6, 7, 8]
>>> parse_int_list("1,4-2")
[1]         # expected [1, 2, 3, 4]
```

Expected: "a-b" means every integer between a and b inclusive in
either order; the result stays sorted.
provenance: upstream code at a pinned commit with an injected regression; the oracle is the unmodified upstream file

source.modifications: reformatted with black (layout and quote style only) to pass the repository formatting check; snapshot adds the injected defect, visible tests and empty package markers

defect: Ranges use the bounds in written order instead of min/max.
